title: Dalrymple ESCRI-SA Battery Energy Storage System: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: ARENA's April 2026 update confirms project completion and the final public report inventory but supplies no post-2021 observation. Phase 56F decision: The project-status and report-boundary questions are closed; the requested later operating series remains absent.
